text:
ellie_marketing: Hey @sam_runtime — prepping slides for the May webinar. Need a quick sanity check: can you rerun embeddings + short-context gen latency on the 13B quantized profile we plan to show? Want median p95 numbers and any weird tail spikes.

sam_runtime: Sure. Do you have the exact payloads we used in the draft deck? small docs vs long docs split?

ellie_marketing: Yeah, two buckets: 1) 3–5 short product blurbs (~50 tokens) for semantic search, 2) 400–800 token docs for snippet embedding + rerank. Also a tiny chat sample for streaming latency (single-turn ~40 tokens). I pasted the sample payloads into the deck notes.

sam_runtime: Got it. I'll run against the quantized-13b-v2 profile on demo cluster (us-west). Expect results in ~90m. Any SLA or region constraints?

ellie_marketing: us-west is fine. SLA: highlight p50/p95 and one worst-case tail. If there are any retries/5xxs plz call out. We need a one-slide summary + raw CSV to attach to the PRD.

carlos_eng: FYI if you use the demo cluster, make sure to set `BATCH_SIZE=4` and `KV_CACHE=true` so numbers match what we show in the blog. Otherwise we'll underreport latency.

sam_runtime: Good call. I'll use `BATCH_SIZE=4` and enable prefix caching. Running with `--openmp-threads=8` per the runbook.

benchbot: bench run queued: id=br-20260502-91 (quantized-13b-v2, us-west, batch4). ETA ~1h 15m.

mira_product: Ellie — can you confirm we want both tokens/sec and cost-per-1k tokens? Marketing wants a simple headline (e.g., "2x faster" or cost delta).

ellie_marketing: Include both. We will craft the headline after we see numbers. If p95 tail > 2s for short queries, flag it and we'll pull it from the slide.

sam_runtime: Update: first pass finished for short blurbs. p50=95ms, p95=420ms, p99=1.8s. No 5xx but 2 retries in one worker due to OOM transient, traced to a host with older CUDA driver.

ellie_marketing: OOM transient — can you capture logs and tag host? We'll decide if we should mention it as a known env issue.

sam_runtime: Yes — attaching the small log excerpt here: ```[worker-42] OOM at step 12: cudart error 700; restarting worker; payload id: short-03```

carlos_eng: That's the host we patched last week; benchbot might've routed there before upgrade finished. Not related to model or quantization.

sam_runtime: Running long-doc bucket now. Rough ETA 35m.

benchbot: bench run br-20260502-91 updated: 40% complete (long-docs in progress).

sam_runtime: Long-doc numbers: embeddings batch median embed latency=210ms, p95=780ms. Gen (single-turn) p50=230ms p95=1.1s. CSV uploaded to /bench-results/br-20260502-91.csv.

ellie_marketing: Awesome — can you add a tiny CSV summary with columns: workload, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, retries, notes? That makes it easier to consume.

sam_runtime: Done. Uploaded summary: /bench-results/br-20260502-91-summary.csv. Notes: 2 transient retries (short bucket), one host driver issue (ignored for headline).

mira_product: Q: did you run with and without prefix caching? Would like both numbers for the deck (cache on vs off).

sam_runtime: I ran with cache enabled. I can rerun cache-off for the short blurbs only — low cost. ETA 25m.

ellie_marketing: Please do the cache-off run. We want to show the delta in marketing copy — cache-on should be the headline but we need the baseline.

sam_runtime: Cache-off short blurbs: p50=180ms p95=1.3s p99=3.6s. Uploaded to /bench-results/br-20260502-91-cache-off.csv.

ellie_marketing: Perfect. Can you also include a one-sentence writeup we can paste into the slide notes explaining test conditions? e.g., region, batch, quantization, cache setting, payload mix.

sam_runtime: Added slide note text to the PR draft: "Measurements captured on us-west demo cluster using quantized-13b-v2, BATCH_SIZE=4, openmp=8. Cache-on results reflect prefix/KV caching; cache-off is cold-prefix baseline. No persistent errors observed; transient OOMs traced to an unpatched host (excluded from headline)."

carlos_eng: Also add that cost estimates assume current GPU price; runbook linked in the PR for methodology.

ellie_marketing: This is super helpful. Final ask: can we get a single PNG of the latency bar chart (short vs long, cache on/off) for the slide? Simple visual — keep axis in ms.

sam_runtime: Yep exporting now. PNG uploaded: /bench-results/br-20260502-91-summary.png.

mira_product: Thanks team. I'll fold these into the webinar slides. Ellie — we'll iterate copy after you draft headlines.

ellie_marketing: Thanks everyone! :raised_hands: I'll review the CSVs and draft the slide. If anything else pops up I'll ping here.

sam_runtime: Ping me if you want the raw run command. Happy to include a short snippet for reproducibility.

ellie_marketing: Please include that snippet in the PR so docs team can reproduce later.

benchbot: bench run br-20260502-91 status: complete. artifacts: br-20260502-91.csv, br-20260502-91-summary.csv, br-20260502-91-summary.png

ellie_marketing: Closing loop — copied artifacts into the marketing drive and updated the PR. Thanks all. :rocket:
